entry.title: Security Council LIVE: UN officials to brief on humanitarian toll in Ukraine
entry.summary:
The Security Council meets this afternoon in New York on the situation in Ukraine. According to UN humanitarians, at least 33 civilians were killed and more than 200 injured between Friday and early Monday, while attacks also damaged critical infrastructure and aid assets. Senior UN political and humanitarian officials are expected to brief Council members on the latest developments and their impact on civilians. Follow the rolling coverage here.
